scope: New component defects found and addressed during this implementation; does not silently replace historical B01-B06 ledger

issues.title: Endpoint worker result did not bind requested task index
issues.risk: A valid result for another index could be saved under requested output
issues.resolution: Require result index equals requested index, test swapped-result refusal

issues.title: Endpoint resource status lost at subprocess boundary
issues.risk: Resource exhaustion could be recorded as generic failure
issues.resolution: Preserve failed worker status and return-code consistency

issues.title: Existing native output was refused after unnecessary execution
issues.risk: Retry could repeat a completed expensive calculation before write refusal
issues.resolution: Refuse existing output before work; atomic claim prevents concurrent duplicate launch

issues.title: Persisted native envelope rejected by raw-result validator
issues.risk: Real wrapper outputs could not enter full-domain assembly
issues.resolution: Validate exact envelope, then pass only its documented raw-result fields to strict raw validator

issues.title: Exact rational denominator and decimal serialization growth
issues.found_by: Actual Frozen107 cutoff probe at precision128
issues.risk: Finite mathematical bounds exceeded rational/string representation limits
issues.resolution: Preserve failed attempts and old source; add rigorously upward-rounded positive dyadic significant-bit representation and re-run bounded actual probes
issues.evidence: runtime/endpoint_cutoff_probe and endpoint_tasks quantization evidence; final outcome in delivery verification

issues.title: Fixed-panel interior mass bound grew artificially with large cutoff
issues.found_by: Actual cutoff probes after representation fix
issues.risk: A valid but overly conservative J_t E_u term grew with T and prevented useful tail tightening
issues.resolution: Use min(J_t,W_t) with independently valid positive-axis bound at fixed pivot1, same donor i/mu/a, cached within task
